_comment: JSON-Schema-SUBSET for build_status_update_payload.py's status-update-emit.json (BC-12942 eval). Validated by scripts/eval/assert_lib.py — supported keywords ONLY: type (name or list; 'null' matches None), required, properties, additionalProperties: false, items, enum, const. Asserts the matrix SHAPE; the golden + golden_compare assert the per-scenario verdict/payload/campaign_id/output VALUES. campaign_id is [string,null] — it carries the injected PRE-write read Id whenever the campaign exists (would_update / would_noop / dry_run) and null otherwise (campaign_not_found / error); unlike create-sf-campaign's always-null post-write id, this is a pre-write read and belongs in the emit. payload/output are left type-only ([object,null]) so the golden locks their (heterogeneous, per-branch) keys — incl. the post-write-null invariants (would_update.output==null; would_noop.output.campaign_url==null).
